title: Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
description_review: Senior remote full-stack developer role building a contractor referral and services marketplace platform across web and mobile. Scope covers user accounts, job tracking, payments, dashboards, and admin tools worldwide. No specific tech stack or salary is disclosed.
pros: Senior full-stack ownership scope fits senior engineering experience
End-to-end platform delivery from scratch aligns with general software engineering background
cons: No Java, Spring Boot, or enterprise backend stack specified
Domain is consumer/contractor marketplace rather than enterprise, banking, or fintech

title: Toptal: Senior Integration Engineer for Enterprise API & Integration Products
description_review: Senior integration engineer role focused on designing and operating enterprise API integrations across MuleSoft, SAP, Salesforce, and carrier data lakes. Emphasizes end-to-end production ownership, API design, contract management, and daily AI-assisted engineering workflows. Remote engagement with day-rate compensation structure.
pros: Explicit daily AI-assisted engineering and agent workflow matches applied AI background
Enterprise integration, API contracts, and architecture align with senior enterprise background
Senior scope with end-to-end production ownership and operational resilience
cons: Centered on MuleSoft, SAP, and Salesforce rather than core Java and Spring Boot development

title: Sticker Mule: AI agent engineer
description_review: Remote AI agent engineer role building and managing autonomous multi-agent systems integrated with internal and third-party tools. Stack spans Go, TypeScript, GraphQL, Postgres, and GCP with frontier LLMs such as Claude, OpenAI, and Grok. Offers $150,000–$250,000 USD annual salary with a $20,000 signing bonus.
pros: Core focus on autonomous multi-agent systems directly matches candidate's multi-agent platform experience
Stack includes TypeScript and Postgres which fit candidate's complementary skills
Attractive transparent compensation ($150k–$250k USD) with full remote flexibility
cons: Requires Go rather than candidate's primary Java and Spring Boot stack
Commerce and manufacturing focus rather than banking, fintech, or legacy modernization

title: Toptal: Senior Data Engineer – AWS Data Lake & Pipeline Architecture
description_review: Senior data engineering position architecting and implementing AWS data lake solutions, SQL data models, and automated data pipelines. Supports data intelligence platforms, web services, and analytics infrastructure for internal business units. Remote contractor position with unstated compensation.
pros: Senior architectural scope covering pipeline automation and scalable data solutions
Involves web services and relational database optimization
cons: Pure data engineering and AWS data pipeline role rather than backend software engineering
No Java, Spring Boot, or microservices application development

title: Proxify AB: Senior Fullstack Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description_review: Senior remote full-stack developer role requiring 5+ years of experience with Node.js microservices, React.js, SQL, and MongoDB. Focuses on building reusable libraries, low-latency applications, and data storage solutions for global clients. CET (+/- 3 hours) preferred with monthly compensation.
pros: Senior microservices architecture and API design scope
Database experience with SQL and MongoDB aligns with candidate's stack
5+ years senior requirements match candidate's 7+ years of experience
cons: Stack centered on React.js and Node.js with no Java or Spring Boot
General client staffing engagement lacking fintech or enterprise modernization context
